trade.headline: Portfolio Access for the Trade
trade.subheadline: Sommeliers, retailers, and restaurateurs: discover allocations, pricing, and market intelligence reserved for our professional partners.
trade.description: The Trade Portal is your direct line to our portfolio. Access current allocations, futures pricing, and exclusive market reports—everything you need to build a world-class Argentine wine program.
benefits: Real-time allocation availability across four markets
Exclusive trade pricing and futures access

cta.title: Apply for Trade Access
cta.subtitle: Join our network of professional partners. Applications reviewed within 24 hours.

society.title: Some Wines Never Reach the Open Market
society.description: Membership is extended by private invitation to a curated group of collectors and connoisseurs. We discover extraordinary wines—small parcels, old vines, winemakers working in secrecy—and share them with our members before anyone else.

discovery.title: The Discovery
discovery.desc: We find wines that don't reach the open market. A single vineyard block in Mendoza, 47-year-old vines, fewer than 800 kilograms of fruit per year. You hear about it first.

revelation.title: The Revelation
revelation.desc: Native yeasts only. 22 months in old French oak. 13.2% natural alcohol at 1,340 meters altitude. Technical detail for those who understand what matters.

scarcity.title: The Scarcity
scarcity.desc: Twenty bottles. Twenty members. Collector members receive allocations based on tenure, engagement, and advocacy. Not purchased—earned.

scarcityNotice.title: Each tier accepts only 20 members per market
scarcityNotice.desc: When capacity is reached, new members may only join by invitation from existing members—or by waitlist.

cta.quote: Access cannot be purchased—it must be earned. Membership is extended by invitation only.

corporate.title: Your wine
corporate.reframe: When your investor asks where the wine came from, the answer should not be a supermarket.
corporate.scarcity: We manage complete wine programs for a maximum of twelve corporate clients per market. Argentine wines only. Boutique producers. Limited allocations.
